title: Scores in range
statement:
Bring every score into the range from 0 to 100.

The input has an `overall` score and a `parts` array of scores. Bonus points and penalties can push a score out of range. A score under 0 becomes 0. A score over 100 becomes 100. Every other score stays as it is. Give an object of the same shape: `overall` as a number and `parts` as an array in the same order.
reference:
def clamp: if . < 0 then 0 elif . > 100 then 100 else . end;
{overall: (.overall | clamp), parts: (.parts | map(clamp))}
